channel.title: The Art Newspaper - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Art Newspaper (theartnewspaper.com)

item.title: 12 must-see exhibitions in and around Los Angeles during Frieze
item.description: From the latest additions to Judith Baca's "Great Wall of Los Angeles" at Jeffrey Deitch and "Monuments" at Moca and the Brick, to the Julia Stoschek Foundation's epic pop-up show of video art and medieval creation stories at the Getty

item.title: Frieze Los Angeles reflects the city’s resilience
item.description: The fair’s seventh edition gathers the local community of dealers and artists, along with dozens of international galleries, while fostering a convivial atmosphere

item.title: New York Historical receives gift of 150 works by Indigenous artists
item.description: The works—including pieces by Jaune Quick-to-See Smith, Fritz Scholder, T.C. Cannon and others—were donated by the chair of the museum’s board of trustees and her husband

item.title: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor post-arrest photo hung in Louvre by activists
item.description: Anti-billionaire campaign group Everyone Hates Elon put the photograph up and called for "justice for all Epstein survivors"

item.title: UK exhibition celebrates the artisans throughout history who went to war
item.description: Fitzwilliam Museum’s new show "War Craft" examines art made on or near the front lines, often from materials found on the battlefield

item.title: Aleksandr Dotsenko, artist jailed in Russia over anti-war supermarket protest, dies
item.description: The Ukraine-born artist died of a heart attack, less than two years after being convicted for placing anti-war slogans in a shop in the Leningrad region

item.title: Earthly delights: new book unravels the mysteries and enduring influence of rock art
item.description: A renowned expert reveals the range of techniques and aesthetics of rock art, and what it tells us about human development

item.title: How do we stem the decline in students studying art history in the UK?
item.description: We need to reframe the subject as one worth knowing about, rather than focusing on its use

item.title: Ukrainian heritage fund takes shape as war enters fifth year
item.description: Countries including the UK and Denmark have pledged to contribute to the new Ukraine Cultural Heritage Fund

item.title: New York State Museum begins $150m modernisation project
item.description: A new era of exhibitions and infrastructure upgrades is coming to the oldest and largest state museum in the US
